svg.title: Queen of the Thrones of Earth: Queen of Pentacles · Water of Earth (Book T deck, painted with its symbols)
svg.desc: Water of Earth; rules from 20° Sagittarius to 20° Capricorn, as Book T counts. Its ring: number 18 in Book T's order, with its part of the zodiac lit. The painting: https://pub-71ebbc217e6247ecacb85126a6616699.r2.dev/flow-image-gen/1795880513775-x76flxl91ys.png (AI painting from Book T's words, prompt by PlayfulProcess, CC BY-SA 4.0). Glyphs drawn for recursive-tarot (CC BY-SA 4.0); composed by scripts/build_book_t_painted_symbols.py.
